about: Written by hand. For each patient, the value of each population define (1 true, 0 false or null) and why.

enc-inside-with-cond.why: Encounter during period (2026-03-15) and has condition.

enc-start-exact-with-cond.why: Encounter starts exactly at period start (2026-01-01T00:00:00) and has condition.

enc-end-exact-with-cond.why: Encounter ends exactly at period end (2026-12-31T23:59:59.999) and has condition.

enc-straddle-after-with-cond.why: Encounter ends after period ends (2027-01-01), so not during period.

enc-before-start-with-cond.why: Encounter starts before period starts (2025-12-31), so not during period.

enc-entirely-before-with-cond.why: Encounter entirely before period; no qualifying encounter.

enc-entirely-after-with-cond.why: Encounter entirely after period; no qualifying encounter.

enc-no-period-with-cond.why: Encounter has no period element, so does not count as during period.

no-enc-yes-cond.why: Has condition but no encounter during period.

yes-enc-no-cond.why: Has encounter during period but no condition.

multi-enc-one-qualifies-with-cond.why: One encounter qualifies (2026-05-20, during period) and has condition.

no-birthdate-enc-cond.why: Encounter during period (2026-09-10) and has condition; birthDate absent but irrelevant.
